packs.notes: Korea-first HR/payroll/accounting fidelity: Labor Standards Act, 4대보험, HomeTax, K-GAAP/K-IFRS, PIPA, ISMS-P, SAPA, rules-of-employment and labor-management-council thresholds.
US expansion keeps payroll tax, benefits, FMLA/ADA/EEOC, GAAP, SOX-style controls, and multi-state employer obligations behind jurisdiction rulepacks.
EU expansion covers GDPR, works-council/local labor overlays, VAT, statutory accounting exports, and data-residency policy.

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: onboarding and offboarding checklists with e-signature
industry_patterns_adopted.source: BambooHR, Workday — structured onboarding reduces time-to-productivity and compliance risk
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: Workflow-driven onboarding task sequence; e-signature adapter for offer letters and contracts via Connect layer

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: compensation bands with pay equity analysis
industry_patterns_adopted.source: SAP SuccessFactors, ADP Workforce Now — compensation benchmarking required for pay equity compliance
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: CompensationBand entity per legal_entity_id; pay equity analysis workflow triggered by band threshold breach

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: performance review cycles: annual, semi-annual, continuous feedback
industry_patterns_adopted.source: Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, BambooHR — multi-cadence performance reviews are table stakes
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: PerformanceCycle entity with cadence enum (annual/semi_annual/continuous/project_based); Workflow routes review, calibration, and close

industry_patterns_adopted.source: Workday Skills Cloud, SAP SuccessFactors — skills taxonomy enables workforce planning and internal mobility
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: SkillProfile entity linked to Employee; skills gap analysis surfaces in manager dashboard; rulepack-backed for KR job classification requirements

industry_patterns_adopted.source: Workday, Rippling — contingent workers require distinct legal treatment from employees
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: payee_class enum includes contractor, contingent, part_time alongside regular_employee; KR 프리랜서 tax treatment routed via payroll rulepack

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: succession planning and org chart visualization
industry_patterns_adopted.source: SAP SuccessFactors, Workday — succession readiness is a compliance and continuity requirement for large orgs
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: SuccessionPlan entity linked to Position in Ontology; org chart rendered from legal_entity_id + manager_id hierarchy

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: AI-assisted scheduling bounded by labor law rulepacks
industry_patterns_adopted.source: Workday WFM — AI demand forecasting with labor law guardrails
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: AI scheduling suggestions surfaced as Workflow inputs; deterministic rulepack (LSA working hours, rest periods) gates final schedule commit

anti_patterns_avoided.anti_pattern: HR admin bypass of purpose-bound sensitive data access
anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: common ERP pattern: superuser HR admin accounts with unrestricted medical/sensitive field access
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: purpose-bound policy + sensitive-read audit events required; no superuser bypass path

anti_patterns_avoided.anti_pattern: global employee records without legal entity scoping
anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: single-tenant HR systems store employees in a global table, breaking multi-entity group compliance
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: legal_entity_id required on every Employee record; cross-entity queries are projection-only

anti_patterns_avoided.anti_pattern: AI-driven employment decisions without deterministic policy
anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: AI hiring/firing recommendations without policy basis create legal liability
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: AI may surface candidate rankings or attrition risk; all employment status changes require deterministic rulepack basis and audit evidence

anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: attendance data exported to Excel for payroll calculation — a common SME anti-pattern
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: approved AttendanceSegment required before payroll derivation; no spreadsheet export as authority

anti_patterns_avoided.anti_pattern: free-form leave policy without statutory compliance check
anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: custom leave rules override statutory minimums without rulepack validation
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: leave rulepack validates against KR LSA minimums (연차, 병가, 육아휴직) before policy application

user_experience.primary_navigation: suite shell with HR, Payroll, Accounting, approvals, evidence, and admin work queues; personal/work context boundaries inherited from the workspace shell where applicable

decision_log.decision: Machine-readable PRD JSON is canonical; no new Markdown PRD is introduced.
OpenTofu + Makefile + oya ops are the deployment/ops path; manual SSH troubleshooting is explicitly out of scope.
HR, Payroll, and Accounting are the first enterprise children; suite model remains extensible for procurement, compliance, assets, and corporate intelligence.

verification_limitations: Official vendor landing pages establish product/category presence and high-level capability areas only; this PR does not claim exhaustive feature parity verification.
New industry_patterns_adopted, anti_patterns_avoided, and hyperscaler_bar entries are product-planning commitments until dedicated Enterprise validators land.
No runtime, CI lane, or schema validator for the new Enterprise hyperscaler_bar dimensions ships in this PR.
